email.body1:
Carmine, saw Connectbase acquired Cloud Age and took growth investment to expand the platform.

An acquisition and new capital usually mean more in-market service providers than the team can personally work, and that is where deals go cold before a rep reaches out. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Connectbase off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Carmine, quick follow-up for Connectbase.

With Cloud Age folded in, the question is usually how many meetings the region needs to convert the wider TAM. Most teams find out late, and by then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Connectbase needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Carmine, last bit of proof for Connectbase.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Connectbase's reply rate likely compares to similar growth-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Carmine, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after an acquisition, timing is everything, and I know integrating a new team is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your region? I will tailor it to Connectbase either way.
